summary: Tested the fix where legal docs are now driven by the backend, on both backend and frontend. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests pass. Public GET /api/legal returns the 6 built-ins in order with source=builtin, no body, Cache-Control no-store. Every legacy alias resolves to its canonical slug. POST with alias 'terms' saves as terms-of-service with overrides_builtin=true. POST on an existing slug gives 409. PUT on a built-in without a custom version creates an override. PUT with a slug that doesn't match the URL gives 400, unknown slug gives 404. DELETE of a custom doc returns reverted_to_builtin=true. DELETE of a built-in with no custom version gives 400. A new slug cookie-policy is listed after the built-ins and returns 404 once deleted. A bad slug or empty title gives 422. A user token gets 401 on every admin legal endpoint. Frontend E2E: on the admin Правовые tab all 6 rows show the 'Встроенный' badge and no revert button. Editing privacy-policy works (slug field disabled, body pre-filled). After saving, the badge changes to 'Свой · заменяет встроенный' and the revert button appears. Creating cookie-policy shows the 'Свой' badge with a trash button. On the user side, /settings immediately lists the new privacy title and cookie-policy. The doc page renders markdown correctly (h1→h2, bold, list items). Refund-policy shows the refund form (refund-upload-btn). Reverting from the admin UI (confirm dialog) brings back the built-in text, and deleting cookie-policy removes it for the user. No page errors. Cleanup done: legal_docs collection is empty, only built-ins remain.

issues: With a long title (e.g. 'User Agreement — Lovreski Platform') the '← Назад' back button wraps onto 2 lines because it has no shrink-0/whitespace-nowrap; the title truncates fine. Fix: add 'shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap' to the back button and 'min-w-0' to the h1 in SettingsPage.jsx (around line 58).

action_items: Minor: stop the back button wrapping on the legal doc header in SettingsPage.jsx (shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap).
critical_code_review_comments: Custom docs without a built-in are sorted by title, not created_at. Fine, but the order changes when an admin renames a doc.
LegalDocBody.body has no max_length, so very large payloads are accepted. Consider a limit such as 200k.
Toast says 'уже видно пользователям', but a user who already has Settings open sees the update only after the useLegalDocs list refetches (on remount). This is acceptable.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. TEST_ docs created during tests were deleted; db.legal_docs is empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Legal docs: built-ins live in backend/legal_defaults.py, overrides in db.legal_docs. Routes are in routers/admin.py (lines ~603-698). Admin UI is at /admin/dashboard?tab=legal; you can inject the token through localStorage 'lovreski_admin_token' (from POST /api/admin/login). The user settings page uses 'lovreski_token'.
